title: EBA Fraud Taxonomy: fraud case classification record
description: Validates one fraud-case classification against the EBA Fraud Taxonomy v6.0. This schema fixes the shape of a record. The permitted values are versioned data in taxonomy.json; the enums below are generated from it by build_schema.py and must not be edited by hand.

taxonomy_version.description: Taxonomy version the record was classified under. Always store it: modi are added, split and retired between versions.

method_code.description: Method (how): attack vector or first point of contact, as an opaque code. Canonical machine value.

method.description: Optional display label for method_code. Not a source of truth.

method_new_description.description: Required free text when method_code is M14 (New method).

modus_code.description: Modus (what): the fraudster's action leading to loss via a payment transaction, as an opaque code. Canonical machine value.

enum: Impersonation of person with authority to instruct payments
Control of card or card details by unauthorised party
Fraudulent use of cash back scheme
modus.description: Optional display label for modus_code. Not a source of truth.

modus_new_description.description: Required free text when modus_code is D999 (New fraud type (describe)).

initiator_code.description: Initiator (who): who initiated the affected payment transaction, as an opaque code. Canonical machine value.

initiator.description: Optional display label for initiator_code. Not a source of truth.

labels_tags_codes.description: Labels/tags (what else) as codes. Optional and deliberately unconstrained: the taxonomy states that the listed labels are suggestions and PSPs may add their own. Values starting with 'L' followed by three digits should resolve to taxonomy.json; anything else is institution-specific.

payment_instrument_code.description: Payment instrument (optional): account-to-account or card, as an opaque code.
